# scramjit

> Python hot loops at native speed: a JIT written in pure Python, compiling through cimo.

## Prompt

- [Prompt for coding agents](https://www.scramjit.dev/agent-prompt.txt): install, API, CLI, what compiles and how to fix what doesn't

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/introduction.md): What scramjit is, where it helps and where it doesn't
- [Install](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/install.md): Installing scramjit, in CPython and in Pyodide
- [Your first function](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/first-function.md): A first @scram function, step by step

## Writing functions

- [Types and annotations](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/types.md): Type inference, annotations as contracts, narrowing
- [Loops and builtins](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/loops-and-builtins.md): How range, zip, comprehensions and other builtins compile
- [Python data structures](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/data-structures.md): tuples, lists, lists of lists, dicts, enums and module-level constants: what compiles, what's copied, what stays Python
- [numpy compatibility](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/numpy.md): arrays as arguments, views, slices, making arrays, what numpy calls compile
- [Semantics](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/semantics.md): Where results match CPython, and why
- [Gotchas](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/gotchas.md): Every known difference from CPython: 64-bit integers that wrap, n ** k with a negative k and x ** 0.5 with a negative x raise; and small functions, Ctrl-C, numpy warnings, debuggers and threads around a compiled call
- [Fallback and errors](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/errors.md): Fallback to Python, FallbackWarning and CompileError
- [Preflight](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/profiling.md): scramjit preflight, f.preflight() and acting on its hints

## Going further

- [Compilation and caching](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/caching.md): When compiling happens, the GIL and the disk cache
- [In the browser](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/browser.md): Pyodide, JupyterLite, marimo and PyScript
- [How it works](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/how-it-works.md): From syntax tree to machine code

## Reference

- [Platforms](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/platforms.md): Supported platforms and security
- [FAQ](https://www.scramjit.dev/docs/content/faq.md): Common questions
